image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a grey whale's head and upper torso emerging vertically from choppy, teal-green ocean water. The whale's skin is dark grey to black, heavily mottled with white patches and barnacle clusters (callosities), particularly on the rostrum and chin. The background shows a distant, hazy shoreline under a pale sky. The body below the waterline is not visible.
